description:
Phalaenopsis orchids, often called moth orchids, are very popular houseplants that are completely safe for cats. They do not contain any known toxic chemicals that would harm your pet if nibbled.

Because they are non-toxic, you do not need to worry if your cat occasionally chews on the leaves or flowers. However, eating large amounts of any plant material might still cause a mild upset stomach. They remain a great, worry-free choice for a cat-friendly home.
name: Phalaenopsis Orchid/ Moth Orchid
